title: UK government briefs defence and infrastructure leaders on Russian threats, citing cyber attacks and sabotage
date_note: The GOV.UK page is dated 24 November 2026 and gives no earlier day for the alert.
org: UK Cabinet Office and Ministry of Defence
geo_basis: UK government departments; city of the departments, not stated by the page
summary: The UK government says closed-door briefings are being given to leaders of critical national infrastructure and defence firms on Russian threats. The GOV.UK release says Russia and its proxies use tactics like cyber attacks, sabotage and disinformation. Armed Forces Minister Louise Sandher-Jones says Russia and other hostile actors pose a growing threat to companies that equip and support the armed forces.
plain: The UK government is briefing defence and infrastructure company leaders on Russian threats, which it says include cyber attacks, sabotage and disinformation.
exec: The UK government says hostile actors pose a growing threat to companies that equip and support the armed forces.
action: The UK government advises reducing digital exposure, improving detection and reporting of hostile reconnaissance, and identifying and protecting critical assets.

sources.name: GOV.UK (Cabinet Office and Ministry of Defence)

validation.note: GOV.UK release read; Yeni Safak relays it. The MI5/NPSA alert page returned 403 and was not read.
